1.consolidated_definition: Fruto de la palma real, ovalado, muy duro, de color verde claro casi gris, blanquecino una vez seco; muy usado como forraje de cerdos.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Fruit of the royal palm, oval in shape, very hard, with a light greenish-gray color that becomes whitish when dry; highly used as pig feed.
